town_description: Ramagundam is an industrial city in Peddapalli district on the Godavari, home to the NTPC Ramagundam super thermal power station (the largest power station in South India) and Singareni coal mines. The NTPC township at Jyothinagar (505215) and adjoining Godavarikhani form its urban core, with Ramagundam railway station as the main railhead.
